observations: Land requires completed Another Slice of H.A.M. and Fishing Contest, plus nonboostable 38 Agility/40 Fishing/45 Thieving/48 Herblore.
Zanik, Makeover Mage, pharmakos berries and a 3-dose goblin potion unlock the guarded Goblin Temple.
Zanik is freed with a Dorgesh-kaan sphere; Bighead's commandments test unlocks black tribe pickpocket.
Aggie requires a Hemenster whitefish caught with raw slimy eel and 5 coins to bleach goblin mail.
Six keys: black, white, yellow, purple, orange and blue. Goblin mail must match each tribe's guard.
Five historical high priests are defeated in succession; Oldak's machine code is 9-4-1 and the quest ends at the Yu'biusk box.
Land completion grants 2 QP, 8,000 each in four skills, and access to Goblin Temple, BLQ and new goblin potions.
Hopespear requires 50 Prayer, completed Land/Desert Treasure I/Fairytale II, ghostspeak and visibility items, a goblin potion.
Hopespear's five priests can be defeated in any order without weapons, armour or attacking spells; individual bones must be picked up before another fight.
Burying the five priest bones on Yu'biusk yields 1,250 + 2,500 + 5,000 + 10,000 + 20,000 = 38,750 Prayer XP.
pending_reviews: Potion doses are modeled as one nonstackable item at each charge level, but restocking and multiple entry attempts require replay checks.
The six colour changes are modeled as one piece of recoloured goblin mail rather than six spare sets; verify alternate mail methods and equipment constraints.
Dorgesh-Kaan and Goblin Cave entrances, crypt scene transitions, local walk durations, machine portal and BLQ coordinates need in-game calibration.
The combat model records planned successful high-priest outcomes; prayer and food use, protection-prayer tactics and player death recovery are unquantified.
The only light-source requirement modeled is lit candle, one of several possible sources; add a light-equipment choice gate later.
Hopespear's no-equipment combat restriction cannot be enforced through the current inventory-only schema; planned outcomes explicitly require it.
Model grants the Hopespear completion flag in a marker after fifth burial, though game completes on the burial itself.
If any bones are lost to death or missed before a subsequent fight, the route must repeat that ghost; recovery loops are not yet cataloged.
A reused potion from Land to Hopespear is a valid sample route, but both can be completed with freshly made potions if doses were consumed.
